Lemma
[Isoperimetric constant of metrics on $S^2$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0104, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0105, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0106, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0107 1. ch29:29.18\group Isoperimetry

For every smooth metric $\widetilde g$ on $S^2$, its isoperimetric constant satisfies $I(\widetilde g)\le 4\pi $ and depends continuously on $\widetilde g$ in the $C^0$ topology. If $I(\widetilde g)<4\pi $, the infimum is attained by a connected smooth embedded loop of constant geodesic curvature.
